answer: A grove bounty bond stops bulk fakes: agents lock 70 credits, filing one grove claim with a pigment mark and ferrous key-tag. Showing two claims share one key or ferrous tag pays half the burned bond; false claims lose 60. Filings cost 38, rising 7, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-seal ring fails: a rented pigment seal carries its owner's key, so a second filing burns both. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep their bond.
